Grokipedia - Customs Clearance Handling Fees in Canada 2026

_metadata.notes: These are handling fees on top of actual duties/taxes. Check with your carrier account for exact rates.

brokerage_fee.notes: 2.75% of fiscal charges (duty + tax), min ~€18. Applies to all international shipments [citation:4]

duty_tax_paid_service.notes: 2% admin fee, min ~€17. DTP service - you pay duties upfront [citation:4]

additional_surcharges.notes: Multiple surcharges stacked on base rates [citation:4]

DHL.international_comparison: DHL is often cheapest express option for international routes despite higher domestic rates [citation:4]

brokerage_fee.notes: US $9.75 for shipments under $200, $19.50 for higher values. Additional add-ons may apply [citation:9]
Contact UPS for specific rates. Known to be higher than DHL for brokerage in many cases [citation:14]
Only applies to dutiable/taxable items. Much lower than private couriers [citation:9]
USPS defers customs processing to destination postal service - no separate brokerage fee [citation:4]

recommendation.for_high_value_or_time_sensitive: DHL Express - best international rates, predictable fees
recommendation.for_low_value: DHL or local postal service - compare brokerage fees vs shipping cost
recommendation.for_canada: Canada Post if possible - only CAD 9.95 fee vs private courier fees
recommendation.for_ddp_shipping: DHL Duty Tax Paid service - 2% admin fee, predictable for customers
recommendation.warning: Since US de minimis is suspended, ALL US-bound shipments will incur duties + brokerage fees [citation:4]
